map.Search Console reports are easy to read: Search Console reports are easy to read as a score: more clicks is good, fewer is bad. Put three of our SEO projects next to each other and the picture gets more interesting.
map.1. The same average position can give di: 1. The same average position can give different click-through rates
map.Skin Body Health and Allen Jacobi Law bo: Skin Body Health and Allen Jacobi Law both averaged position 17.5, which is usually the second page of results. One earned a 3% click-through rate and the other 4.8%. Position decides whether people can see you. The title, the description and how closely the page matches the search decide whether they click.
map.2. A lower average position can still co: 2. A lower average position can still come with a high click-through rate
map.Pure Hope Weight Loss has the lowest ave: Pure Hope Weight Loss has the lowest average position of the three (24.5) and the highest click-through rate (5.2%). Average position blends every search the site appears for. A handful of well-matched searches ranking near the top can lift the click-through rate while many others sit far down the results. The report we were given does not break this down, so we treat it as a question to investigate, not a conclusion.
map.Allen Jacobi Law had the most impression: Allen Jacobi Law had the most impressions (9.85K) and the most clicks (471). Pure Hope had the fewest impressions (3.83K) and the fewest clicks (201). Clicks follow impressions, so growth means appearing for more of the searches your customers really use. In the Allen Jacobi Law and Pure Hope projects that included adding long-tail keywords, the longer and more specific phrases people type. Skin Body Health started with targeted keywords and fresh content.
